name: tab-bar
title: Tab Bar
summary: The floating bottom navigation of iOS in liquid glass, with a lens that glides and stretches between tabs.
use_when: Switching between 3 to 5 top-level sections of a phone app or mobile web app
A bottom bar over scrolling content
avoid_when: More than 5 sections: use a sidebar or a menu
Actions such as Save or Share: use a toolbar

props.items: Tabs: value, label, icon and an optional href
props.onValueChange: Called with the tab's value when it changes

copy.label: One word per tab, at most 12 characters

a11y: A tablist: arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs
Tabs with an href mark the current page with aria-current
Labels stay visible under the icons
prefers-reduced-motion moves the lens without the spring
